subject: Acme Corp renewal + new workloads — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Carter <john.carter@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Renewal discussion + potential new workloads (Q4 usage review)

Hi John —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Wanted to capture the key points and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. Please reply with any edits.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Current primary usage: text generation for customer support (avg 40M tokens/month), embeddings for semantic search (4M units/month).
- Main pain points:
  - Latency spikes during support peak hours (affects SLA for tier 1 support).
  - Cost variability: token costs spike on long-context model runs for analytics workloads.
  - Need for audit logs and stricter retention controls for regulated data.
- Goals for next 12 months:
  - Stabilize latency to <200ms p50 for support paths.
  - Add a dedicated workload for reporting/analytics (higher context lengths) and evaluate quantized model options to control cost.
  - Execute renewal with expansion to cover the analytics workload by March/April.

Proposed upsell path and timeline:
1) Add "Dedicated Capacity" pool for support + short-context models (immediate: Q1) to guarantee throughput and reduce p50 latency.
2) Trial quantized model variant for analytics workload (2-week POC) to validate cost savings and quality.
3) If POC meets quality guardrails, roll analytics workload into Dedicated pool + add 25% committed capacity (targeted for March 2026 renewal amendment).

Immediate next steps (action items):
- I will send the Q4 usage export, current pricing options, and a draft amendment for the renewal (attached).
- John/Procurement: confirm internal approvals and timing for the amendment by end of Jan.
- Rishi/Dylan: schedule a short technical kickoff for the POC next week.

Attachments included: usage_report_Q4_2025.csv, redwood_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing scenarios + Dedicated sizing).

If that all looks right, I’ll prepare the amendment and DocuSign link.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
